gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu keeps its midline set high and its counters linked to the outside, a plain sans that stays easy on the eye. Snowburst One brings the stencil punch, with wide breaks between letters and a loud, expressive attitude.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, bold and expressive, with openings as wide as a sprung paper clip. Noto Sans Thai Looped answers with spacious curve terminals and sturdy bodies.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tifina: Rounded and inviting, Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with inflated-looking bowls that never close up. And Snowburst One sits over them as a stencil-cut display face, loud where the body text is welcoming.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-ugarit: Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between letters and tall, loud lowercase. And Noto Sans Ugaritic then reads approachably, its x-height nearly touching the capitals and its open mouths like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-vai: Expressive from the first stencil cut, Snowburst One is all wide bridges and a gaping, paper-clip opening. Noto Sans Vai handles the quieter job, its words forming solid blocks with generous room where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet in type form, bold and expressive, with wide bridges between letters. Noto Sans Wancho hits back with hulking lowercase pressed down like thick chalk, its e left gaping at the terminal.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-warang: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One breaks its letters apart with wide bridges. And Noto Sans Warang Citi pulls the other way, forming solid word blocks with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-yi: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One looks like a sheet of punched letters. Noto Sans Yi settles in underneath with a deep midsection and rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, so the loud heading has a modern, quiet partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-zanaba: Gaping stencil bridges define Snowburst One. Its big, bold letters carry the heading, while Noto Sans Zanabazar Square follows with a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-traditional: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between them and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Noto Traditional Nushu relaxes beside it, with broad-nibbed strokes and bowls that fill the line.
